text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the end of the year fast approaching 
on this day, I visited Nakayama Racecourse 
with Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Uuu~, there are so many people, I can't 
move forward at all~...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Still, this really feels like the Arima 
Kinen! After all, it's a race full of 
popular Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Plus, the Prez is running too, so that's 
probably hyping everyone up even more! 
Sasuga, Pre~z!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Next year, I might be out on the track 
myself! Like, "The Classic Champion, Tokai 
Teio!" or somethin'!
choice_data_list: Let's do our best so we can get there.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh? Isn't that... over there!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It's Air Groove after all!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Teio and her Trainer, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove, you came to watch too! Who are 
you cheering for? The Prez? It's gotta be 
the Prez, right! Totally!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You really get extra noisy whenever it 
involves the Student Council President."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I didn't come here to make a racket like 
you. I came to watch so that it will 
elevate my own running.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You came here to study? Man, you student 
council folks really are diligent~.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Come to think of it, Air Groove, 
aren't you running in the Arima Kinen?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If I could run, I would be running.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, with my current ability, I still 
cannot reach this grand stage...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Even Air Groove can't 
participate...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If even Air Groove, who proved herself by 
beating Tokai Teio in a practice match, 
can't run, then—
choice_data_list:
It takes considerable ability just to 
enter that race.

It takes considerable ability just to 
enter that race, huh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah……

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your goal was to surpass the President, 
wasn't it? Then you had better watch 
closely.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To see what kind of running the President 
will show on this stage that even I cannot 
reach...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
See with your own eyes just how high the 
wall you're trying to climb really is.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: The height of the wall...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the gates opened for the grand 
finale of the year-end—the "Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the leading pack turns into the final 
stretch! Which Umamusume will surge 
forward from here?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
One breaks away from the pack here! 
Symboli Rudolf! It's Symboli Rudolf!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf crosses the finish line 
first! Japan's number one is the "Triple 
Crown Umamusume," Symboli Rudolf!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAHHH~~~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Teio, it's no wonder you are at a loss for 
words.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"In the midst of such fierce competitors, 
the President delivered an extraordinary 
run."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The path you seek to tread is an 
extraordinarily steep and perilous one...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: A rugged path...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even on the train ride back, Tokai Teio 
remained unusually quiet.
choice_data_list: Symboli Rudolf was in a league of her own.

Symboli Rudolf was in a league of her own, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I've always thought it was amazing, 
but still...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Once I made my debut and stood on the same 
stage, I really understood just how 
incredible they truly are.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The Pre-z I thought was so close to me 
suddenly felt so far away...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh... Nnnngh...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! No matter how much I think about 
it, my feelings won't change!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You know, I've been thinking about this 
ever since the race ended...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I really want to surpass the Prez! Even if 
I know it's a steep road ahead!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sure, it was shocking to realize how far 
away I still am, you know? But still...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Because I've always looked up to the 
Prezy! Even before I entered the academy, 
and right now! And forever into the 
future, too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So no matter how amazing the Prez is, I 
won't give up. Never, ever!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is Tokai Teio's true strength— a 
power even Symboli Rudolf acknowledges...!
choice_data_list: Let's seize our dream, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, leave it to me! I'm definitely going 
to overtake you, Prez!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With my resolve toward Symboli Rudolf 
reaffirmed, it's finally time to advance 
to the Classic Year!
